summary: Myriad Genetics filed an 8-K disclosing an Asset Purchase Agreement, dated October 19, 2026, to sell its prenatal health business—including Foresight, Prequel, FirstGene and SneakPeek tests—to Laboratory Corporation of America for $210 million cash plus closing inventory value. Buyer will offer employment to certain business employees and has obtained representation and warranty insurance. Closing conditions include HSR clearance, state health care approvals, no restraining litigation and no material adverse effect. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The deal is structured as an asset sale with customary indemnities; watch antitrust and state regulatory timing, plus any purchase price adjustment for inventory.
